text:
```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Cache Bun modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.bun
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('bun.lockb') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run CI preflight
        run: bun run ci:preflight

      - name: Build donor package
        run: turbo run build --filter=@asym/donor

      - name: Upload donor build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: donor-build
          path: packages/donor/dist

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results

      - name: Test Reporter
        if: always()
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          artifact: test-results
          name: Test Results
          path: test-results/**/*.xml
          reporter: jest
```
